status.en: 16 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 45% fewer than the week before, most of them in Baghdad, Kirkuk and Erbil.
status.nb: 16 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 45 prosent færre enn uken før, flest i Baghdad, Kirkuk og Erbil.

summary.en: Iraq is dealing with multiple domestic crises, including a major hospital fire in Baghdad that forced more than 60 evacuations and a crackdown on a kidney-sale loan ring in the capital. The government barred security forces from intervening in the dollar exchange market and reiterated that they have no role in setting rates, while also warning that attacks on Riyadh’s King Khalid International Airport threaten regional stability. Iraq condemned the airport attack and warned that it could destabilise the region, and it is accelerating its air-defence upgrade to finish three years ahead of the coalition exit. The country’s prime minister is planning visits to Saudi Arabia and Kuwait, and Barzani met the Finnish ambassador to discuss security and ties between Erbil and Baghdad. The conflict recorded 396 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Irak håndterer flere innenlandske kriser, inkludert en stor brann på et sykehus i Bagdad som tvang mer enn 60 evakueringer og en nedslag på en låne-ring for nyresalg i hovedstaden. Regjeringen forbød sikkerhetsstyrker å gripe inn i dollarmarkedet og gjentok at de ikke har noen rolle i å fastsette kursene, samtidig som de advarte om at angrep på Riyadhs King Khalid internasjonale flyplass truer regional stabilitet. Irak fordømte flyplassangrepet og advarte om at det kan destabilisere regionen, og landet akselererer oppgraderingen av luftforsvaret for å bli ferdig tre år før koalisjonens uttrekning. Landets statsminister planlegger besøk til Saudi-Arabia og Kuwait, og Barzani møtte den finske ambassadøren for å diskutere sikkerhet og bånd mellom Erbil og Bagdad. Konflikten registrerte 396 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Iraqi conflict
background.extract: The Iraqi conflict is a series of violent events that began with the 2003 American-led invasion of Iraq and deposition of Iraqi dictator Saddam Hussein, followed by a series of conflicts including the protracted Iraq War (2003–2011), the Iraqi insurgency (2011–2013), the War in Iraq (2013–2017), and most recently, the small-scale Islamic State insurgency in 4 provinces located in Northern Iraq since 2017.
